children: Sensata Technologies reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1B, up 7.7% from $932M a year earlier. Net income was $114.2M, compared with a net loss of $162.5M, while diluted EPS was $0.78 versus a loss of $1.12 per share.
¹ Reported as “Net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income/(loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income/(loss) per share”.
Third-quarter organic revenue grew 6.8%; nine-month organic revenue increased 5.1%.
Automotive organic revenue rose 2.6%, supported by $24M in EV program cancellation revenue and partly offset by lower vehicle production.
Industrials organic revenue grew 11.8%, primarily reflecting content growth.
Aerospace and commercial equipment organic revenue increased 13.2%, driven by growth in both markets and favorable product mix.
Lower costs and restructuring savings helped lift operating income. Sensata expects 2026 capital spending of up to $125M.
